before: A load marked the edges of a link inside a control's prompt as prompt items, while the room makes a new link round prompt words with unmarked edges. The loaded link then read as a control inside the prompt, so content over the prompt left the link and its words when a pending suggestion was on them, unlike the same room before a fold.
after: A load marks a prompt's words and a control's open item, not the edges of a link or another container in it (markPrompt in load/state.ts), so a link in a prompt reads the same live and after a fold.
reason: Change messages, the change log and its kinds keep their meaning, and the Yjs document format and the checkpoint format (version 5) do not change. Only how a load labels a link's edges in a prompt changes, as the room labels them. An ordered room admits only clients of its own code version, and ordered rooms are not deployed yet, so no room needs a migration.
